create_workspace.title: New workspace
create_workspace.description: A workspace holds multiple projects and team members.

create_project.description: The project key (2–5 letters) prefixes ticket numbers, e.g. CORE-42.

rename_project.title: Rename project
rename_project.description: Only the name changes — key {{key}} and the project page link stay the same.
rename_project.validation_name_min: Project name must be at least 2 characters

services_knowledge.intro: Projects and their linked services — Popov uses this combination when analyzing incidents. RAG & knowledge details live in the Services tab.
services_knowledge.no_projects: No projects in this workspace yet.
services_knowledge.dialog_description: Pick from your library or create a new one — services stay yours and are reusable across projects/workspaces.
services_knowledge.picker_empty: No services available to add — switch to Create new mode.
services_knowledge.service_id_hint: Lowercase letters/numbers/-/_ — free to create. RAG & knowledge details are managed in the Services tab.
services_knowledge.saved_unlinked_toast: Service saved to library — link it manually via the picker
services_knowledge.unlink_description: The service is unlinked from this project. The library entry stays intact.
services_knowledge.delete_bullet_services: {{count}} services will be unlinked from this project
services_knowledge.delete_bullet_archive: All tickets & chats get archived (data intact in DB)
services_knowledge.delete_bullet_slug: Slug & key become available for new projects

knowledge.title: Workspace Knowledge
knowledge.description: Used by Popov Agent when analyzing incidents via chat/tickets in this workspace.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge in this workspace yet.
knowledge.admin_empty_hint: Add from My Library — new documents are saved to your personal library automatically.
knowledge.picker_description: Documents stay yours — the workspace only references them. Library updates appear here instantly.
knowledge.picker_empty: All your library documents are already linked (or your library is empty).
knowledge.unlink_description: Popov Agent will no longer use this knowledge for this workspace. The original document stays INTACT in its owner's library.

registry.intro: Monitoring services owned by this workspace — supervisor routing & log analysis use this list (replacing global config). Link to projects via the project page.
registry.empty: No registered services yet — routing uses global config (.env fallback).
registry.fill_db_first: Fill in the log connection first
registry.dialog_description: Services are free to create (like K8s deployments). Log DB connection is optional — the agent uses it to analyze this service's transactions.

hierarchy.intro_strong: Hierarchy: service → RAG log DB → linked knowledge. Supervisor routing & log analysis use this list. These services are scoped to this workspace — general/cross-workspace services are managed in Management → Services (General).
hierarchy.empty: No registered services yet — routing uses global config (.env fallback).
hierarchy.fill_db_first: Fill in the log connection first
hierarchy.knowledge_empty: No knowledge linked to this service yet.
hierarchy.manage_knowledge_title: Manage knowledge — a library entry is created automatically if none exists
hierarchy.dialog_description: Services are free to create (like K8s deployments). Log DB connection is optional — the agent uses it to analyze this service's transactions.
hierarchy.delete_confirm_desc: Supervisor routing will no longer recognize this service. Linked knowledge stays intact in its owner's library.
hierarchy.edit_doc_description: Changes are picked up by all consumers automatically.
hierarchy.owner_only_read_error: Only the document owner can read it
hierarchy.owner_only_edit_error: Only the document owner can edit it
